problems.quote: mother calls for help, backs into breakfast table and overturns coffee
problems.evidence: "When she reached the table, she sat down heavily on it, as if absent-mindedly, and did not appear to notice at all that next to her coffee was pouring out onto the carpet in a full stream from the large, overturned pot."
problems.explanation: The event is labelled as source text, but the text never says the mother overturned the pot; it only reports the pot already overturned and her not noticing, so her causing the spill is inferred.

problems.quote: Cries for help, flees into table, spills coffee
problems.evidence: "did not appear to notice at all that next to her coffee was pouring out onto the carpet in a full stream from the large, overturned pot."

result.note: Nearly all records are labelled as guessed, sketched or inferred and stay within the text read, apart from two low-severity cases of the mother being credited with spilling the coffee.
